entries.sourceRef: Listing-identifier window declared by the operator for this work item from 2021-04-01 (the start of the oldest audited period in the dataset). THIS DATE IS AN OPERATOR RECORD, NOT A FILING FACT. Identity evidence: the CIN L45200MH2005PLC152061 is printed at FY2025-26 report PDF p.119 (Note 1, General Information); the ISIN is printed at PDF p.107, where the filing states "Identification Number allotted to the Equity Shares of the Company is INE389H01022"; and that same page states "The Equity Shares of the Company are listed on BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited". Neither annual report prints a trading symbol or a BSE scrip code anywhere in its 215 and 206 pages. The NSE symbol KEC was corroborated on 2026-11-07 from NSE's own quote-routing payload for get-quotes/equity?symbol=KEC, which carries symbol: "KEC" and companyName: "KEC-International-Limited" (source/identity-nse-corroboration.json). BSE was fetched the same day and returned only a JavaScript shell with no company content, so the BSE leg is deliberately NOT asserted and no BSE scrip code is invented.
